# Homelab 2026: What I'm Running

My homelab has evolved significantly this year. Current stack:

| Service | Host | Notes |
|---------|------|-------|
| Proxmox VE | Dell R720 | 256 GB RAM, 12 cores |
| TrueNAS SCALE | Custom build | 48 TB usable |
| Kubernetes (k3s) | 3× Raspberry Pi 5 | Lightweight workloads |
| Wireguard | VPS | Remote access |

Power consumption sits around 180 W idle. Not bad for the capabilities.
